mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) solutions can increase GI motility and reduce drug absorption time, potentially decreasing rivaroxaban bioavailability and anticoagulant efficacy.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; avoid PEG bowel preparation within 24 hours of rivaroxaban dosing when possible, or consider temporary anticoagulation bridging if bowel prep is necessary.
